Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> was involved
in creating it too, wasn't he?

supposed to be recorded in the <book(78)>Ageha Plan<endbook()>.

<on()><sp(20)>But the current thinking is that the <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()>
and <book(73)>Antibody Coralians<endbook()> are hostile to each other.

<on()><sp(20)>Let's think about it chronologically.

<on()><sp(20)>At the time, there was a theory that
the <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()> and the <book(69)>Scub<endbook()> had some kind of connection.

<on()><sp(20)>Both Dr. <book(68)>Adroc<endbook()> and Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>
were researching the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>,
each from the angle of their own specialty.
